doc.brief: The QGraphicsObject class provides a base class for all graphics items that require signals, slots and properties.
doc.index_brief: Base class for all graphics items that require signals, slots and properties

void enabledChanged().brief: This signal gets emitted whenever the item gets enabled or disabled.

void grabGesture(Qt::GestureType gesture.brief: Subscribes the graphics object to the given *gesture* with specific *flags*.

void opacityChanged().brief: This signal gets emitted whenever the opacity of the item changes

void parentChanged().brief: This signal gets emitted whenever the parent of the item changes

void rotationChanged().brief: This signal gets emitted whenever the rotation of the item changes.

void scaleChanged().brief: This signal is emitted when the scale of the item changes.

void ungrabGesture(Qt::GestureType gestu.brief: Unsubscribes the graphics object from the given *gesture*.

void visibleChanged().brief: This signal gets emitted whenever the visibility of the item changes

void xChanged().brief: This signal gets emitted whenever the x position of the item changes

void yChanged().brief: This signal gets emitted whenever the y position of the item changes.

void zChanged().brief: This signal gets emitted whenever the z value of the item changes.

effect.brief: The effect attached to this item

enabled.brief: Whether the item is enabled or not

rotation.brief: The rotation of the item in degrees

visible.brief: Whether the item is visible or not

x.brief: The x position of the item

y.brief: The y position of the item

z.brief: The z value of the item
